mechanism: Atomoxetine inhibits norepinephrine reuptake while tranylcypromine is a non-selective MAOI, creating risk of noradrenergic excess, hypertensive crisis, and serotonin syndrome through combined monoamine potentiation.
action: Contraindicated combination; do not use together; allow minimum 14 days washout after MAOI discontinuation before starting atomoxetine, or 5 days after atomoxetine before starting MAOI.
